kypExtensions.summary: The four original KYP mnemonics (ZERO = AMOUNT, FIRST = FRACTION / STUCK RATE, STRAIGHT LINE / ZERO'S HALF-LIFE WANDERS, FIRST'S HALF-LIFE HOLDS / FLOOD THE ENZYME, FLATTEN THE LINE). The source's own margin mnemonic — “A PEA is round, shaped like the “0” in zero-order.” — is carried VERBATIM with attribution (it is NOT counted among the four KYP codes).
kypExtensions.rationale: The page prints exactly one mnemonic (A PEA, the zero-order example list); the four ALL-CAPS rate-rule, curve-shape, half-life-signature, and saturation-crossover codes are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: mnemonics + blocks[4] the mnemonic-provenance callout + the visual's panel markers

kypExtensions.summary: The dual-signature miniCase — a salicylate overdose whose serial levels fall by a fixed AMOUNT every 2 h with an 18-hour apparent half-life, paired with a phenytoin 10%-dose-increase trap (trough more than doubles, nystagmus/ataxia) — one saturated mechanism, two faces.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the two columns and the figures but never integrates them into a numeric overdose-vs-titration vignette; the fixed-amount arithmetic, the 18-h vs 2–4-h half-life contrast, and the four distractors (first-order misread, flow-dependent misfile, protein-binding conflation, invented CYP inhibition) are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The slope-chip reading protocol (CHIP TEST → LINE TEST → BRACKET TEST → TAG TEST → CROSSOVER TEST) and the saturation-crossover framing (rate = Vmax·Cp/(Km + Cp): below Km first-order, above Km zero-order) — KYP's synthesis of the two figures and the two mechanism tags into one protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two figures side by side with interleaved text-layer labels; the five-gate reading order, the fork banner (constant AMOUNT vs constant FRACTION), and the Michaelis–Menten bridge are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: blocks[2] the steps block + mechanisms[1] slope-reading-map + the registry visual

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot attack structure layered over the source facts — 5 patterns (linear salicylate fall, fixed-rate ethanol, flow-dependent high-extraction, phenytoin titration jump, figure reading), 5 traps (constant amount vs fraction, linear vs exponential, the bracket symbols, capacity-limited vs flow-dependent, aspirin's dose-range qualifier), 3 pivots.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two definitions, the tags, the examples, and the figure labels only; the attack structure is a KYP design.

notes: SHARED PAGE (the p196 convention): pdf 252 / book 230 carries two subsections — Drug metabolism (top half, sibling topic drug-metabolism) and Elimination of drugs (bottom half, this topic); only the elimination block's contiguous lines (part1.txt page-252 lines 49-118) are quoted, and the interleaved figure labels are quoted in physical order as the text layer prints them. PEA PROVENANCE: “A PEA is round, shaped like the “0” in zero-order.” is First Aid's own margin mnemonic (book 230, printed in the margin directly under “Capacity-limited elimination.” — VLM: red bold PEA/“0”/“zero-”); it is carried verbatim with attribution and is not counted among the four original KYP mnemonics. FIGURE-DIRECTION DECISION (documented): the production brief's glosses said the zero-order half-life 'LENGTHENS as concentration falls' / 'each successive half-life interval is LONGER' — the literal printed chain 'First t1/2 > Second t1/2 > Third t1/2' means each successive interval is SHORTER down the curve (at a constant 2 U/h, 16→8 takes 4 h, 8→4 takes 2 h, 4→2 takes 1 h), matching the zero-order annotation 'Time of t1/2 ↑ as concentration ↑', the VLM bracket reading ('the FIRST half-life interval, at the highest concentration, is drawn longest'), and standard pharmacokinetics; the note ships the correct reading (half-life lengthens as concentration RISES). A second focused VLM pass disagreed on the small arrow glyphs (a known VLM limitation) — the text layer (which preserves ↑/↓ and the > / = symbols verbatim) was treated as authoritative. Census (pdfimages + VLM, scripts/usmle-pipeline/ph4-vlm-census.ts): ZERO rasters; two VECTOR figures redrawn as original KYP art. Quirks, documented: (1) part1.txt page-252 line N = ph1-p252.txt line N+1 (the pre-extracted file's banner line); (2) the text-layer line-wrap renders the PEA line's trailing word 'zeroorder.' (hyphen at the print line break) — the note carries it as printed, 'zero-order'; (3) productionStatus uses the schema's ProductionStatus vocabulary value 'pilot-complete' (the P-batch manifest convention; the per-record INVENTORY productionStatus is 'complete'); (4) outputs are STAGED under .usmle-pipeline-cache/staging-ph4/ — nothing is written into content/ (chapters/pharmacology.json, content manifests, visual-inventory, and the visual registry are owned by the promotion step; the note's visualId 'elimination-kinetics-map' is therefore not yet in visuals/registry.tsx by design).
